theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.84%) and Industrials (-0.16%) led the market today, while Utilities (-1.95%) and Real Estate (-1.55%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.98%, defensives -0.94%, and value/cyclicals -0.39% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.75%, Dow -0.68%, Nasdaq -1.13% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.77%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 6.83% to 15.18, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.23% to $4,326.30, crude oil was little changed at $92.23, and bitcoin slipped 2.05% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
